title: Kestrel and the Blue Hour
author: Casper Galloway
blurb: Beatrix Underhill, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
